social.title: Feeling Left Out
social.text: Your friends make plans without inviting you.
choices: Take a moment to calm down

sensitive.title: Noisy Classroom
sensitive.text: The classroom is loud, and you cannot focus.

independent.title: Group Project
independent.text: A teammate makes all the decisions without asking you.
choices: Explain how you want to contribute
Ask the group to discuss roles

perfectionist.title: One Small Mistake
perfectionist.text: You find one mistake in a project you worked hard on.

needs_space.title: Crowded Room
needs_space.text: Too many people are standing close to you.
choices: Ask others to give you some space
